test_get_values_for_csv: test the _get_values_for_csv method of DatetimeIndex to format datetime values for CSV output with custom date formats and NA representations
test_dti_with_timezone_repr: test DatetimeIndex repr with timezone localization using US/Eastern and dateutil/US/Eastern timezone strings
test_dti_repr_time_midnight: test DatetimeIndex repr for midnight dates with different frequencies and time units
test_dti_representation: test DatetimeIndex string representation for various cases including empty indices, timezone-aware indices, and NaT values
test_dti_summary: test the _summary method of DatetimeIndex to generate summary strings for indices with different sizes, frequencies, and timezones
